row.notes: In Game_SaveSlotManager_SelectSlot right after mov [rsi+0x280], rbx: rbx = the SaveSlotInfo being loaded (slot_id [rbx], slot_guid [rbx+8]), rsi = the slot manager. A read here sees the career id before its blob deserialises (0x1429d1270 at 0x1429d0c5b); a later failure restores the old slot at 0x1429d0c6a. Signature game.save_slot_selected (save-re); the core's career id reads it (native/src/core/career/save_splice.cpp, snapshots/runtime.cpp).

verify.notes: V1468 sigcheck OK hits=1 at 0x1429d0c40 (3083/3083 pass); the 15-byte pattern has no wildcards and also matches once in the whole image. Target 0x1429d0c47 is cmp qword [rbx+0x178],0 (8 bytes, no RIP-relative operand), so the 5-byte patch sits inside one instruction and je 0x1429d0c4f is not displaced. Linear sweep of the .pdata body 0x1429d0b90-0x1429d112f: no branch lands in 0x1429d0c48..0x1429d0c4b and none targets the site; no rel32/rel8 from elsewhere either (the one disp hit at 0x1429f32c7 is mid-instruction of jae 0x1429f30a5).

V1469 rsi = rcx (manager) at 0x1429d0b99, never rewritten; rbx = *[slots+i] matched by cmp [rbx],rdx (slot_id) at 0x1429d0bc3, not written again before the site; the site runs right after mov [rsi+0x280],rbx. Two caveats for consumers: if the blob load 0x1429d1270 fails, 0x1429d0c6a puts the old slot back in +0x280, and a new career's slot becomes current in 0x1429d1890 (mov [rdi+0x280],rbx at 0x1429d1a27) without passing this site; core's career_loaded re-reads +0x280 and logs the new-career case, so both are covered there.
